'''TTC droid chips''' were chips produced by [[Teagan Tech Consortium]] to transform [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] into [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droid]]. Some chips were used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to sabotage [[Droid/Legends|droids]] acquired by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], which led to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Shadow Raptor revolt|revolt]] on the ''[[Shadow Raptor]]''.
